summary: BTC holdings increased to 847,363 as of June 28, 2026 (no new purchases this week, reflecting updated cumulative total). Strategy also announced a Digital Credit Capital Framework including repurchase programs for preferred and common stock, a BTC monetization program, revised STRC dividend policy (rate raised to 12.00%), and a USD Reserve policy; 12.67M common shares were sold via ATM for ~$1.15B in net proceeds.

Strategy sold 3,588 BTC during June 29–July 5, 2026 to fund preferred stock distributions, reducing holdings to 843,775 BTC as of July 5, 2026; no equity was issued under the ATM program and no other capital structure changes were reported.
Strategy acquired 520 BTC during June 15-21 2026 for ~$34.9M, bringing total holdings to 847,363 BTC as of June 21, 2026. Also sold 2,714,839 MSTR common shares under ATM for $335.5M net proceeds.

Strategy acquired 1,587 BTC during June 8-14 2026, bringing total holdings to 846,842 BTC as of June 14, 2026, funded by $209.0M in net proceeds from ATM sales of 1,732,553 MSTR common shares. No changes to debt, converts, or preferred liquidation preference were disclosed.

Strategy acquired 1,550 BTC for ~$101.3M during June 1-7 2026, bringing total holdings to 845,256 BTC as of June 7, 2026. Common stock ATM activity of 1,409,600 shares sold for $181.0M net proceeds; no changes to debt or converts.
Restored btc/btc_as_of to the 2026-07-06 8-K state (843775 @ 2026-07-05): three older June 8-Ks were applied after it, regressing the pair (pre-guard). Guard now prevents recurrence.

As of March 31, 2026, Strategy held 762,099 BTC (up from 672,500 at year-end 2025), purchased ~89,599 BTC during Q1 2026 for ~$7.25B. Weighted average basic/diluted shares were ~333.9M for Q1 2026; convertible note structure (2028, 2029, 2030A, 2030B, 2031, 2032) remained unchanged in face amounts.

10-Q cover page (owner-read): 330,807,622 class A + 19,640,250 class B = 350,447,872 shares outstanding as of 2026-04-26. Replaces the Q1 weighted-average mis-extraction; diluted set null until a filing states it.

Strategy acquired 535 BTC during May 4-10 2026 bringing total holdings to 818,869 BTC as of May 10 2026, funded by $43.0M in ATM proceeds from sales of 231,324 MSTR common shares and 1,412 STRC preferred shares.

Strategy agreed to repurchase approximately $1.50 billion aggregate principal amount of its 2029 Convertible Notes, reducing the 2029 Notes outstanding from $3.0 billion to approximately $1.50 billion after cancellation expected around May 19, 2026.

Strategy acquired 24,869 BTC during May 11-17 2026 for ~$2.01B, bringing total holdings to 843,738 BTC as of May 17, 2026. ATM activity included 430,344 MSTR common shares ($83.7M net) and 19,519,801 STRC preferred shares ($1,949.0M net) sold during the period.

As of May 25, 2026, Strategy holds approximately 843,738 bitcoin acquired at an aggregate cost of $63.87 billion (~$75,700 avg). No ATM share sales or bitcoin purchases occurred during May 18–25, 2026.

BTC holdings decreased to 843,706 as of May 31, 2026 (32 BTC sold for ~$2.5M net). MSTR ATM sold 801,994 common shares for $128.3M net proceeds; no changes to debt, converts, or preferred liquidation preference stated.
